verdict.rationale: BugSnag is an error-monitoring SaaS, not an AI agent or assistant host, so consuming MCP servers (the MCP client role) is outside its product category. The evidence shows only an official MCP server (bugsnag-probe-3, bugsnag-docs-21), which lets other agents connect to BugSnag. That is the separate server-side story and does not make the client axis applicable.
